bio.text: Chris Gober won the Republican nomination for Texas's 10th Congressional District outright in the March 2026 primary, taking 51.25 percent of the vote in a 10-candidate Republican field, according to Texas Secretary of State figures as of the next morning reported by The Texan.
The Texan describes him as a former lawyer for Elon Musk.

sources.title: Chris Gober wins GOP Primary for Congressman Michael McCaul's Seat | 2026 | The Texan
